summary_en: 417,000 shares (6.01% of S/O), ¥100M ceiling. Open-market acquisition window 18 June 2026 to 31 August 2026. Subsidiary company stock buyback; rationale: capital structure reform and dividend reinstatement preparation.
title_en: Notice regarding decision on acquisition of treasury stock by consolidated subsidiary Saika-ya Co., Ltd.
translation_en_brief: AFC-HD Ams Life Science Co., Ltd. announced on 18 June 2026 that its subsidiary Saika-ya Co., Ltd. (TSE Standard, code 8254) has resolved to acquire up to 417,000 treasury shares (6.01% of shares outstanding excluding treasury) for a maximum of ¥100 million. The acquisition window runs from 18 June 2026 to 31 August 2026 via open-market purchases. Saika-ya states the buyback supports its capital structure reform program and dividend reinstatement plan following completion of a capital reduction (effective 20 May 2026) that eliminated accumulated losses and restored the company's ability to pay dividends. The company intends to resume a 5-yen dividend this fiscal year and will pursue both dividends and opportunistic buybacks as complementary shareholder returns alongside capital efficiency improvement. The filing notes that market conditions may result in partial or zero execution of the authorized program.
